name: Harbinger
description: The Harbinger was a large experimental landing ship designed to conquer and hold planets for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Custom-built by the Geonosians for Count Dooku, leader of the Confederacy, the ship boasted a compartmentalized efficiency that allowed it to deploy armies within minutes, and its supercharged light drive made it perfect for invading unsuspecting star systems.

data.name: Harbinger
data.complement: Several squadrons of tanks and walkers
